what_happened: The the person running Athena re-tiered the queue's priorities by hand, which is Athena's job. When the owner pointed this out, the the person running Athena queued two jobs so Athena would own it. 20261031-082442-92qg adds a focus record and caps on urgent and high items. 20261031-082446-vq7x adds a steward triage pass on each drain.
cause: Athena has no stage that grooms the queue, and priority tiers have no cap or review. The the person running Athena therefore fixes ordering by hand each time it degrades, and nothing makes Athena own the task or flags the the person running Athena's hand work as something to hand over. Routine queue upkeep stays with the person running Athena, who falls back on doing it directly. This is the same cause as the existing priority-inflation class: tiers are unbounded and no triage path exists.
prevention: Build queue triage into Athena. Keep a focus record, and cap the number of items in the urgent and high tiers, with the cap enforced by code at filing time. Run a steward triage pass on every drain that re-tiers items, retires duplicates and items already done, and logs what it changed. Once this exists, an the person running Athena who edits priorities by hand should be treated as an intervention and logged. Together these would have prevented the whole class.
proposed_request: Make Athena own queue priority so the the person running Athena never re-tiers by hand. (1) Add a focus record that states the owner's current priorities, kept as a typed record the records validation accepts. (2) Enforce caps on the number of urgent and high items in code when an item is filed or re-tiered. Refuse or demote an item that would exceed the cap, and say why. (3) Add a steward triage pass that runs at the start of each drain. It reads the focus record, re-tiers queued items to match it, flags duplicates and items already done for retirement, and logs every change. Do not make the triage pass touch a running job. Acceptance: a test with a queue of mixed real-shaped items shows the caps hold, the triage pass reorders them by the focus record, and the triage log lists each change. A test shows a drain with an empty queue or no focus record runs normally. Related queued jobs are 20261031-082442-92qg and 20261031-082446-vq7x. Keep the work consistent with them and do not duplicate them.
